card.name: End of Juréia place name
card.fires_on: The final piece "ia" of the Brazilian place name Juréia, mostly in Serra da Juréia and Juréia-Itatins. Weaker on endings of other foreign proper names.

modes.label: Juréia ending
modes.description: The closing "ia" of Juréia in descriptions of the Serra da Juréia region.
modes.example: The Serra da Juré<<ia>> is a Precambrian horst.

modes.label: Other foreign name endings
modes.description: Final syllables of other foreign names or plant names, such as Furetière or timboúva.
modes.example: Antoine Fureti<<ère>> met to discuss literary questions.

card.plain: It fires on the last syllable of the place name Juréia, and a little on endings of other accented foreign names.
